body: Lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-07 10:43Z, my own over-caution, challenged by Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #819/#821). Fast-forwarding DL560's TermAl checkout (/home/greg/github/TermAl) to LANDED, gated master and building it into that checkout's target/release, with the running pid untouched and no restart, needs NO fresh word from Greg. CLAUDE.md:268 limits writes to the repository folder. The DL560 checkout is TermAl's repository on that host, the same clone class remote runners work in. CLAUDE.md:296–299 needs Greg's explicit word only for writes OUTSIDE the repository. The landing (:181–189) installs the gated tree's binary where the host runs it from. Restart 1's „Tak” was caution, not a rule. Do not ask Greg for this again. Restarts stay Greg's. Building an UNlanded tree, or anything outside the checkout, is a different matter.
